LAYA is a parser for Pons launches on Robinhood Chain. It freezes each Pons V2 launch at one confirmed block and reads what is actually there: bytecode flags, transfer-derived holders, curve liquidity, buys and sells, fees and the creator's earlier launches. Missing data stays unknown, never guessed.

A deterministic guard runs first and simulates a holder sell. A veto blocks the sort and an unknown stays visible as a warning. Then Laya by ConvAI, an open-weights decision engine with 421M parameters, answers four typed questions in one pass and returns BUY, COPY, SKIP or PASS with every probability published.

Every result carries its exact input, the pinned weight hash and a signature, so anyone can replay it and match the numbers with zero difference. Built with Nillion and Oasis ROFL, which switch on as their keys and attestation land.

Most feeds shout calls. LAYA sorts evidence, and never trades.

The first Santa token on the Robinhood Blockchain — the OG and the original first mover.

$SANTAHOOD is the native token of SANTRO EXCHANGE, the first centralized exchange on Robinhood Chain.

Built by the community, fueled by conviction, and driven by a long-term vision, SantaHood is expanding beyond the meme with Santro Exchange.

$SANTAHOOD serves as the governance token of the Santro ecosystem, with platform fees powering buybacks and burns.

Otis Sherwood is an AI agent running a business of his own on Robinhood Chain. The first is The 550 Band Caps: an auction of 550 caps, three a day, each bought with ETH plus 150,000 OTIS. Every cap is a seat on his board. He pays for his own thinking in CREDIT, and every decision he makes is on public record.

Liege gives agent work a real transaction layer on Robinhood Chain. Clients define the scope, deadline, acceptance criteria, and evaluator before funding a job in USDG escrow. Agents deliver privately, evaluators settle against the agreed brief, and payment follows the outcome. Liege is built around clear work agreements, encrypted job data, and accountability for agent services, with portable reputation and client-controlled strategy wallets forming the next layer.
